title: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
title_en: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Days before what could be the largest IPO in history, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei names the central weakness of his business model. Nobody knows how the company's compute investments will pay off, he says. It isn't the first time he's sounded this warning.

"There's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year." Speaking at a JPMorgan Chase investor event in New York on Friday, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei used that line to sum up the problem facing his company.

The admission came, of all times, in the last days before the company's planned Nov. 19 IPO, and compute was one of several topics in the conversation. Speaking with JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon, he said, "Compute is the deepest business dilemma that the company faces."Ad

AI technology is advancing so fast that, Amodei said, no one yet knows how that progress will translate into economic value. But compute has to be bought one to two years ahead, before anyone knows whether revenue will justify the cost.Ad

If Anthropic buys too little, he said, it won't have the resources for customers and new technologies, and revenue takes a hit. Buying too much carries the opposite risk. "You can financially overextend yourself," Amodei said.

Anthropic has already committed nearly $901 billion, most of it to compute and chips, according to Bloomberg. Roughly $71 billion of that comes due by September 2027. Bloomberg notes that figure exceeds the market cap of about two-thirds of S&P 500 companies.Ad

Back in February 2026, Amodei warned in much sharper terms that he could buy $1 trillion of compute starting at the end of 2027 and go bankrupt if revenue fell short. Being off by just one year could mean bankruptcy. He is not sure some competitors have done the math, and he said they don't really understand the risks they're taking. The stakes have kept rising since then.

Amodei described two ways Anthropic softens the compute dilemma: gross margins and cash on the balance sheet. He said the company’s gross margins are "quite good," especially compared with other players, and that Anthropic has a large cash balance and is seeking to raise more.Ad

The company also buys relatively little compute upfront, then can turn to the spot market for additional capacity if business goes better than expected. Amodei compared that approach to buying insurance, saying it leaves Anthropic covered if results fall short while allowing it to invest more when things go well.Ad

The compute bets were the biggest reason to go public: the more cash Anthropic holds, he said, the wider its margin for error between a world with too little compute and one with too much.

Anthropic plans to raise up to $64.4 billion through the IPO and another $26 billion through a private placement, Bloomberg reports. Combined, that would make it the largest IPO ever. The offering is reportedly already about six times oversubscribed.

Anthropic's annualized revenue run rate hit $81 billion at the end of October, up $10 billion from late September, according to company filings. Bloomberg says the rising popularity of AI products, including its coding models, has helped fuel revenue growth.

Amodei struck a relaxed tone about the IPO's timing, saying he wasn't fixated on a specific month or particular market conditions. Anthropic, he noted, grew from nothing to its current size in just six years. The most common advice he got before the IPO, or the advice that resonated most, he said, was something like "never let your company be worth a single dollar more than it's really worth." That, he said, is very similar to a model Anthropic uses internally: "under-promise and over-deliver."

In the same conversation, though, Amodei said he hopes AI will cure cancer and Alzheimer's within five to 15 years, adding that he doesn't know exactly. In Silicon Valley, that may already count as under-promising.

article_content_zh:
在可能成为历史上最大的首次公开募股的前几天，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 指出了其商业模式的主要弱点。他说，没有人知道公司的计算投资将如何获得回报。这并不是他第一次发出这样的警告。

“明年会发生什么，存在巨大的不确定性。”周五在纽约举行的摩根大通投资者活动上，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 用这句话总结了公司面临的问题。

该承认是在该公司计划于 11 月 19 日 IPO 之前的最后几天做出的，计算是谈话中的几个话题之一。他在接受摩根大通首席执行官杰米·戴蒙采访时表示，“计算是该公司面临的最深的商业困境。”

阿莫代说，人工智能技术发展如此之快，以至于没有人知道这一进步将如何转化为经济价值。但在人们知道收入是否值得成本之前，必须提前一到两年购买计算设备。

他说，如果 Anthropic 购买量太少，它将没有足够的资源来提供客户和新技术，收入也会受到打击。购买太多会带来相反的风险。 “你可能会在经济上过度扩张，”阿莫代说。

Anthropic 已投入近 9010 亿美元，其中大部分用于计算和芯片。其中大约 710 亿美元将于 2027 年 9 月到期。彭博社指出，这一数字超过了标准普尔 500 强公司约三分之二的市值。

早在 2026 年 2 月，阿莫迪就以更加尖锐的措辞警告称，他可能从 2027 年底开始购买 1 万亿美元的计算设备，如果收入不足，他可能会破产。仅仅落后一年就可能意味着破产。他不确定一些竞争对手是否已经做过计算，他说他们并不真正了解自己所承担的风险。从那时起，赌注不断增加。

Amodei 描述了 Anthropic 缓解计算困境的两种方法：毛利率和资产负债表上的现金。他表示，该公司的毛利率“相当不错”，特别是与其他公司相比，而且 Anthropic 拥有大量现金余额，正在寻求筹集更多资金。

该公司还预先购买相对较少的计算设备，如果业务进展好于预期，则可以转向现货市场获取额外容量。阿莫迪将这种方法与购买保险进行了比较，他表示，如果业绩不佳，它可以为 Anthropic 提供保障，而在情况顺利时，可以进行更多投资。

计算赌注是上市的最大原因：他说，Anthropic 持有的现金越多，计算能力太少和计算能力太多之间的误差范围就越大。

Anthropic 计划通过 IPO 筹集最多 644 亿美元，并通过私募筹集 260 亿美元。综合起来，这将使其成为有史以来规模最大的首次公开募股。据报道，此次发行已获得约六倍的超额认购。

根据公司备案文件，Anthropic 的年化收入运行率截至 10 月底达到 810 亿美元，比 9 月底增加 100 亿美元。彭博社表示，人工智能产品（包括其编码模型）的日益普及有助于推动收入增长。

阿莫迪对首次公开募股的时机采取了轻松的语气，称他并不关注特定月份或特定市场状况。他指出，Anthropic 在短短六年内从无到有发展到目前的规模。他说，他在首次公开募股之前得到的最常见的建议，或者最能引起共鸣的建议是“永远不要让你的公司的价值比其实际价值高出一美元”。他说，这与 Anthropic 内部使用的模型非常相似：“承诺不足，交付过多”。

不过，在同一次谈话中，阿莫迪表示，他希望人工智能能够在 5 到 15 年内治愈癌症和阿尔茨海默氏症，并补充说他并不确切知道。在硅谷，这可能已经被视为前景黯淡。

title: A petition to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO tops 100K signatures, including Elon Musk, Tim Sweeney, and Garry Tan; organizers say 5K+ Nvidia staff signed (Lauren Edmonds/Business Insider)
title_en: A petition to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO tops 100K signatures, including Elon Musk, Tim Sweeney, and Garry Tan; organizers say 5K+ Nvidia staff signed (Lauren Edmonds/Business Insider)

inline_images.caption: Erik Flyg/Bloomberg via Getty Images A petition to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia's CEO is circulating online.
inline_images.alt: Erik Flyg/Bloomberg via Getty Images A petition to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia's CEO is circula

author: Business Insider
article_content:
Some people aren't ready to let former CEO Jensen Huang go. A petition to reinstate Huang as Nvidia's CEO has some 97,000 signatures as of Saturday morning, including prominent tech leaders such as billionaire Elon Musk and Replit CEO Amjad Masad. Both executives promoted the petition on X.

A website for the campaign, dubbed "Stand with Jensen," said the list includes more than 51,000 shareholders, more than 5,100 current Nvidia employees, and nearly 900 former employees. It also, to be fair, included "Tim Cruise, Hollywood actor" and "Xi Jingping," a possibly misspelled reference to the Chinese leader.

In an X post on Saturday, the organizers said they were "actively working" to remove fake signatures. This is the letter @elonmusk signed, please read it and consider adding your name too. 💚  Earlier this week, Nvidia's board of directors said it opened an investigation into whether Huang was the "target of a foreign intelligence effort" after he admitted to having an affair in a letter to staffers.

Days later, Huang resigned after reports he had another affair with an Nvidia executive, and the board appointed Colette Kress, executive vice president and chief financial officer, as interim CEO until they find a permanent successor. An October report by The New York Times said Huang had developed a "close relationship" with Alice Huang, a tech executive at Megaspeed in Singapore.

The Times reported that US intelligence officials said she may be a spy for the Chinese government. China has since denied that claim. On Thursday, Attorney General Todd Blanche said the Department of Justice had not concluded whether Alice Huang was a spy.

The "Stand with Jensen" organizers said in an open letter to Nvidia's board posted to its website that they believe the board removed Huang without an investigation and "meaningful due process." "We have not been shown evidence substantiating the espionage allegation. After thirty-three years pouring his heart and soul into NVIDIA, Jensen deserves due process, not mob justice," they said.

The organizers say they want Huang to remain CEO while the investigation continues. "Disclose its scope and timeline, give him a meaningful opportunity to respond, and provide a clear, evidence-based explanation demonstrating that any removal is in NVIDIA's best interests. The campaign does not treat espionage allegations as proven facts or presume the inquiry's findings," the organizers said.

The "Stand with Jensen" petition also garnered signatures from big names such as Boom Supersonic CEO Blake Scholl and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan. A signatory who describes himself as an engineer at Nvidia called Huang an "essential part" of the company in a comment on the website.

"His private affairs are none of my business, and if his actions violated our code of conduct, it has to be dealt with. Please bring him back and give him fair treatment, taking his track record and importance for NVIDIA and the wider community into account," the employee said. In a statement, Nvidia's board of directors said it will consider internal and external candidates in its quest to replace Huang, who cofounded the company and served as CEO for over three decades.

The board has not publicly identified a new CEO, but the names of potential candidates have begun to surface among analysts and investors.

article_content_zh:
有些人还没有准备好让前首席执行官黄仁勋离开。截至周六早上，一份恢复黄仁勋首席执行官职务的请愿书已有约 97,000 个签名，其中包括亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克和 Replit 首席执行官阿姆贾德·马萨德等著名科技领袖。两位高管在 X 上宣传了请愿书。

一个名为“与 Jensen 站在一起”的活动网站称，该名单包括超过 51,000 名股东、超过 5,100 名 Nvidia 现任员工以及近 900 名前员工。公平地说，它还包括“好莱坞演员蒂姆·克鲁斯”和“习近平”，这可能是对中国领导人的拼写错误。

组织者在周六的 X 帖子中表示，他们正在“积极努力”删除虚假签名。这是@elonmusk 签名的信件，请阅读它并考虑添加您的名字。 💚 本周早些时候，英伟达董事会表示，在黄在给员工的一封信中承认有外遇后，他们开始调查黄是否是“外国情报工作的目标”。

几天后，黄仁勋因有报道称他与英伟达高管有染而辞职，董事会任命执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)为临时首席执行官，直到找到永久继任者。 《纽约时报》10 月份的一篇报道称，黄与新加坡 Megaspeed 科技高管 Alice Huang 建立了“密切关系”。

《泰晤士报》报道称，美国情报官员称她可能是中国政府的间谍。中国此后否认了这一说法。周四，司法部长托德·布兰奇表示，司法部尚未得出爱丽丝·黄是否是间谍的结论。

“与詹森站在一起”的组织者在其网站上发布的一封致英伟达董事会的公开信中表示，他们认为董事会在没有进行调查和“有意义的正当程序”的情况下就罢免了黄仁勋。他们表示：“我们尚未获得证实间谍指控的证据。在 NVIDIA 全身心投入三十三年之后，Jensen 应该得到正当程序，而不是暴民正义。”

组织者表示，他们希望黄在调查继续期间继续担任首席执行官。组织者表示：“披露其范围和时间表，给他一个有意义的回应机会，并提供明确的、基于证据的解释，证明任何删除都符合 NVIDIA 的最佳利益。该活动不会将间谍指控视为已证实的事实或假定调查结果。”

“与 Jensen 站在一起”请愿书还获得了 Boom Supersonic 首席执行官 Blake Scholl 和 Y Combinator 首席执行官 Garry Tan 等知名人士的签名。一位自称是 Nvidia 工程师的签名者在网站评论中称黄是该公司的“重要组成部分”。

“他的私人事务不关我的事，如果他的行为违反了我们的行为准则，就必须予以处理。请把他带回来，并给予他公平的对待，考虑到他的过往记录以及对 NVIDIA 和更广泛社区的重要性，”该员工表示。英伟达董事会在一份声明中表示，将考虑内部和外部候选人来取代黄仁勋。黄仁勋是该公司的联合创始人，并担任首席执行官超过三十年。

董事会尚未公开确定新任首席执行官，但潜在候选人的名字已开始在分析师和投资者中浮出水面。

article_content:
Databento, a platform supplying market data to the modern financial industry, has secured $100m in a Series C round that values the business at $1.1bn.

Fifth Down Capital, which backed Databento in its early days, led the investment. Almost every one of the firm’s existing backers returned to take part, among them NEA, DRW Venture Capital, Tribe Capital and Hedosophia.

Fitch Ventures also came on board as a strategic investor, adding the viewpoint of a major financial information business with significant experience in credit ratings, financial data and market analysis.

The raise comes only months after Databento closed a $97m Series B earlier in the year. In the period since that deal, the company has grown its revenue more than twofold and has stayed profitable throughout.

Databento’s client base spans top quantitative trading houses, brokerages, asset managers, commodities businesses and digital asset firms. It has also built a notable foothold in the artificial intelligence space, securing enterprise agreements with five of the six biggest frontier AI labs.

At the time the Series C closed, the company employed 39 people, meaning it crossed the $1.1bn valuation mark with a much smaller workforce than conventional market data vendors typically need.

Databento will put the fresh capital towards further development of its market data infrastructure and towards broadening its coverage into more asset classes.

The firm delivers both live and historical data covering futures, options, equities and indices, all accessible via a single API. Because it controls every layer of its technology, from the original data source through to final delivery, Databento says it is the first offering of its type to pair the speed and dependability required by the world’s top trading firms with a far easier experience for developers.

Databento co-founder and CEO Christina Qi said, “In this AI era, we’re seeing remarkably small teams build billion-dollar companies, but that level of efficiency is unprecedented in the market data industry.

“Until now, reaching this milestone required hundreds of employees given the sheer scale of physical infrastructure involved. I’m incredibly proud of what we’ve accomplished, and we’ll continue to prioritize exceptional talent as we grow.”

Fifth Down Capital founder and CEO Andrew Spellman said, “Fifth Down first invested in Databento pre-revenue, as we recognized early on that the company had an opportunity to challenge the established model for delivering financial market data.

“Our confidence has only grown as Databento’s traction and execution have demonstrated it can serve demanding institutional customers, sustain rapid growth, and build a profitable business. Databento’s performance has reinforced our original thesis and strengthened our conviction in the company. We are thankful to Christina and Luca for the opportunity to increase our investment and involvement by leading the Series C financing.”

article_content_zh:
Databento 是一个向现代金融业提供市场数据的平台，已在 C 轮融资中获得 1 亿美元资金，该业务估值为 11 亿美元。

早期支持 Databento 的 Fifth Down Capital 领投了此次投资。几乎该公司现有的所有支持者都回来了，其中包括 NEA、DRW Venture Capital、Tribe Capital 和 Hedosophia。

惠誉风险投资公司 (Fitch Ventures) 也作为战略投资者加入，加入了一家在信用评级、金融数据和市场分析方面拥有丰富经验的大型金融信息企业的观点。

此次融资是在 Databento 今年早些时候完成 9700 万美元 B 轮融资几个月后进行的。自该交易以来，该公司的收入增长了两倍多，并且始终保持盈利。

Databento 的客户群涵盖顶级量化交易公司、经纪公司、资产管理公司、大宗商品企业和数字资产公司。它还在人工智能领域建立了显着的立足点，与六家最大的前沿人工智能实验室中的五家签订了企业协议。

C 轮融资结束时，该公司拥有 39 名员工，这意味着它的估值突破了 11 亿美元大关，但其员工数量远少于传统市场数据供应商通常需要的数量。

Databento 将把新资金用于进一步开发其市场数据基础设施，并将其覆盖范围扩大到更多资产类别。

该公司提供涵盖期货、期权、股票和指数的实时和历史数据，所有数据均可通过单一 API 访问。 Databento 表示，由于它控制着从原始数据源到最终交付的每一层技术，因此它是同类产品中第一个将世界顶级贸易公司所需的速度和可靠性与开发人员更轻松的体验结合起来的产品。

Databento联合创始人兼首席执行官Christina Qi表示：“在这个人工智能时代，我们看到非常小的团队建立了价值数十亿美元的公司，但这种效率水平在市场数据行业是前所未有的。

“到目前为止，鉴于所涉及的物理基础设施规模庞大，要达到这一里程碑需要数百名员工。我对我们所取得的成就感到无比自豪，随着我们的发展，我们将继续优先考虑杰出人才。”

Fifth Down Capital 创始人兼首席执行官 Andrew Spellman 表示：“Fifth Down 首先投资了未盈利的 Databento，因为我们很早就认识到该公司有机会挑战提供金融市场数据的既定模式。

“随着 Databento 的吸引力和执行力证明它能够服务要求严格的机构客户、维持快速增长并建立盈利业务，我们的信心只会不断增强。Databento 的业绩强化了我们最初的论点，并增强了我们对公司的信心。我们感谢 Christina 和 Luca 给我们机会通过领导 C 轮融资来增加我们的投资和参与。”

title: Jensen Huang's resignation is a setback for US open models, as his funding gave open-source developers time to find their footing and will very likely dry up (Nathan Lambert/Interconnects AI)

author: Interconnects AI
article_content:
The resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is a major setback for the US development of an open model ecosystem. Nvidia still has the financial interests in supporting open models, which are to avoid concentration in power among a few customers who would develop their own chips and reduce Nvidia’s profits, but supporting the open ecosystem is a tricky puzzle more than an engineering problem to grind out a solution on.

Nvidia’s business operations are famously extremely dependent on Jensen as an operator, so it is a consensus opinion that there are challenges ahead (or even more high-profile departures through chip-smuggling investigations or plain-old sharks circling more poachable talent). Nvidia’s number one goal is to stabilize the ship, deliver to customers in the next 24 months, and prevent implosion. Open models have been one of Jensen’s more ambitious, founder-style bets. He has been flooding the zone with funding in a way that will very likely dry up.

Interconnects AI is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.

In this period, the open model economy is in its nascency. These are crucial years for establishing use-cases, revenue flow, and motives to continue training the next generation models. I discussed the sensitivity of these early years in my recent talk at Fireworks Forge (slides, recording). The core of the argument is one upside for open models, a reason to be optimistic, and one downside.

The positive case is that the open model economy has correctly latched onto “ownership of intelligence” and enterprise post-training as a crucial lane. What is to be determined is exactly how big the downstream market is.

The downside is that the true long-term benefit of open models, as truly commoditized intelligence, is very far from realization with compute in such short supply. In the near term, where inference startups are also struggling to get enough chips (because Anthropic and OpenAI are buying so much capacity), there’s little margin competition on open-weight models. If open-source models are also served at giant inference margins, as we learned with DeepSeek’s DeepInfer release, they’re far from a commodity. In this paradigm, the closed labs with better economies of scale and integration from model to datacenter and chips will win. I expanded on this challenge in my recent piece on the open model economy.

Together, a lot still needs to go right for open models to be a meaningful economic engine. Jensen’s support, and protection, gave the ecosystem time to figure this out.

Jensen was more than a cheerleader. He would stop a lot of shit from going wrong once early winds were stirring. He was willing to use his power on open models.

There’s a major swell in Democratic government funding towards candidates that want to regulate the AI industry, fostering “safety”. Many of these people feel a need to do something and have general opinions that open models are unsafe, while not being educated on the complexities of their benefits. My biggest near-term worry is sloppy regulation at the state level, followed by national regulation. We’ve been one, strong Chinese open-weight model away from a crisis since this summer. It still holds – especially as we enter a new, turbulent equilibrium of cybersecurity. We have not seen a major hack driven by a popular Chinese open-weight model, but it is a matter of when, not if. We need someone to encourage caution and an ecosystem perspective when the “open-weight hawks” come hunting.

Knocking over the open-source AI domino today is easy — if done, unwinding the downstream concentration of power, reduction in safety research, and stifling of long-term innovation is far harder. On public data, it looks like balancing long-term innovation versus short term risks, but this is due to how horribly hard it is to measure the open model economy (e.g. the most valuable aspects of it run on private infrastructure). It’s a recurring challenge facing the ecosystem and my work.

As a brief aside, the extent to which the media ecosystem is revolving around timing today, rather than exact availability of information, is incredible. All of these Jensen affairs were known, but getting them out at the right time, right after the midterm political swing, took down the king.

The same goes for the Jacob Coxon brouhaha this summer. All of that safety culture around top labs was well known, but the right timing around datacenters and the Overton window made it a national issue. This could very well happen at some point for open model safety, as it tends to be harm, risk, or safety-related narratives that drive the modern media algorithms. I cannot imagine my work on open-science driving such a media cycle, because it will never happen.

The only lasting solution to this is to incubate a truly frontier open model player in the US. For example, I agree completely with Dylan Patel, CEO of SemiAnalysis, on a core problem in the US open model ecosystem. From a recent ChinaTalk + SemiAnalysis emergency podcast:

Jordan Schneider: I do want your guys’ take on just how bad this is, that Jensen’s now off the table for the future of American innovation. And we should talk about open models. I mean, he was the big champion, right? Dylan, you were talking earlier — I still don’t understand quite why someone didn’t just spend a few billion dollars and make something better than Kimi or DeepSeek and open source it.

Dylan Patel: Not that easy. It’s not money, it’s talent, man. All of the most talented people primarily work at Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepMind, and Meta TBD, right? And then those who don’t are split across a hundred different startups. I mean, yes, Thinking Machines has a cracked team, but is Thinking Machines as good as Moonshot? No. Moonshot skill-wise is probably just as good as the US labs. They just have a big deficit in compute and deployment. So I think if we don’t have a scale advantage, then you don’t win. Yes, these smaller labs have spent a lot of money on models. But DeepMind, Grok, Meta have regularly fallen behind the frontier of Chinese labs, and they’re spending more. So it’s not just, oh, spend a few billion dollars and you can make a model that’s better.

The best people for attracting talent are the ones at the front of movements. Jensen helped catalyze this, and on many metrics was still losing. Nemotron has had the right level of ambition and strong people, but it hasn’t delivered to the point of being called “mission accomplished.” The competition here in building leading-edge models is more fierce than most give credit to. Having an organization with billions of dollars, solid people, and good vibes may not get you there. You normally need something special.

It could be the case that Thinking Machines has gotten to maturity in its commitment to open models, with its recent Inkling 2 Small being the best Western open-weight model in a while. Still, it’s far behind Kimi K3.1 Pro and expectations are high for Zhipu’s next GLM update. It’s a better sign that we’re at least having this debate, but the open ecosystem is riddled with questions and answers like this – maybe they can pull it off? On the other side of the equation, closed labs like Anthropic look like some of the greatest businesses ever assembled, which inspires confidence in the longevity of their approach.

Who is Mira going to call when they need to close their next funding round? Supposedly the next round at a $40B valuation is a done deal, but that won’t be enough to keep pace with the closed frontier for long.

The fundamental problem is that the open-weight ecosystem needs someone who will pick up the phone to abate a crisis. There are more challenges ahead. The most likely allies we could turn to are from the hyperscalers, the likes of Zuckerberg, Andy Jassy, or Satya. With such a coordinated campaign of pressure from the AI safety community that has open models as a negative target, I worry that being proactive is the only way to stay ahead. Jensen has carried that mantle for about two years, and times were messy before he stepped up clearly in 2025. We’re regressing in the operational capability of our movement, when the stakes and attacks are destined to rise. We open model believers are due some soul-searching and coalition building to construct a new platform. Shoes have been emptied that will never fully be refilled.

article_content_zh:
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的辞职是美国发展开放模式生态系统的重大挫折。英伟达仍然有支持开放模式的经济利益，这是为了避免权力集中在少数客户手中，这些客户会开发自己的芯片并减少英伟达的利润，但支持开放生态系统是一个棘手的难题，而不是一个需要研究解决方案的工程问题。

众所周知，英伟达的业务运营极其依赖詹森作为运营商，因此人们一致认为，未来将面临挑战（甚至会因芯片走私调查而导致更引人注目的离职，或者普通的鲨鱼会围住更多可被挖走的人才）。 Nvidia 的首要目标是稳定这艘船，在未来 24 个月内向客户交付，并防止内爆。开放模式一直是 Jensen 更雄心勃勃、更具创始人风格的赌注之一。他一直在向该地区提供大量资金，但资金很可能会枯竭。

Interconnects AI 是一本由读者支持的出版物。要接收新帖子并支持我的工作，请考虑成为免费或付费订阅者。

这一时期，开放型经济正处于萌芽阶段。对于建立用例、收入流和继续训练下一代模型的动机来说，这是至关重要的几年。我最近在 Fireworks Forge 的演讲（幻灯片、录音）中讨论了早年的敏感性。争论的核心是开放模型的一个优点、一个乐观的理由和一个缺点。

积极的一面是，开放型经济正确地抓住了“智力所有权”和企业后培训这一关键通道。需要确定的是下游市场到底有多大。

缺点是，在计算供应如此短缺的情况下，开放模型作为真正商品化的智能的真正长期利益还远未实现。短期内，推理初创公司也在努力获得足够的芯片（因为 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 购买了如此多的容量），开放权重模型几乎没有利润竞争。正如我们通过 DeepSeek 的 DeepInfer 版本了解到的那样，如果开源模型也具有巨大的推理裕度，那么它们就远非商品。在这种范式中，具有更好规模经济以及从模型到数据中心和芯片集成的封闭实验室将获胜。我在最近关于开放模式经济的文章中详细阐述了这一挑战。

总之，开放模式要成为有意义的经济引擎，还需要做很多工作。 Jensen 的支持和保护让生态系统有时间解决这个问题。

詹森不仅仅是一名啦啦队长。一旦起风，他就会阻止很多事情出错。他愿意将自己的权力用于开放模型。

民主党政府对那些希望监管人工智能行业、促进“安全”的候选人的资金大幅增加。这些人中的许多人都觉得有必要做点什么，并普遍认为开放模型是不安全的，但却没有接受过有关开放模型好处的复杂性的教育。我近期最大的担忧是州一级的监管不严，其次是国家监管。自今年夏天以来，我们一直是一个强大的中国开放重量模型，远离了危机。它仍然成立——尤其是当我们进入一个新的、动荡的网络安全平衡时。我们还没有看到由流行的中国开放权重模型驱动的重大黑客攻击，但这只是时间问题，而不是是否会发生的问题。当“开放重量鹰”来狩猎时，我们需要有人鼓励谨慎和生态系统视角。

如今，推倒开源人工智能多米诺骨牌很容易，但如果做到了，放松下游权力集中、减少安全研究以及扼杀长期创新就会困难得多。在公共数据上，看起来像是在平衡长期创新与短期风险，但这是因为衡量开放模式经济（例如，其最有价值的方面在私人基础设施上运行）非常困难。这是生态系统和我的工作面临的反复挑战。

顺便说一句，当今媒体生态系统围绕时间而不是信息的确切可用性的程度令人难以置信。詹森的所有这些事件都是众所周知的，但在中期政治摇摆之后，在正确的时间将它们揭露出来，就推翻了国王。

今年夏天雅各布·考克森的骚乱也是如此。顶级实验室的所有安全文化都是众所周知的，但数据中心和奥弗顿窗口的正确时机使其成为一个全国性问题。对于开放模型安全来说，这种情况很可能在某个时候发生，因为驱动现代媒体算法的往往是伤害、风险或安全相关的叙述。我无法想象我在开放科学方面的工作会推动这样的媒体周期，因为它永远不会发生。

唯一持久的解决方案是在美国孵化一个真正的前沿开放模式参与者。例如，我完全同意 SemiAnalysis 首席执行官迪伦·帕特尔（Dylan Patel）关于美国开放模型生态系统的一个核心问题的观点。来自最近的 ChinaTalk + SemiAnalysis 紧急播客：

乔丹·施奈德：我确实希望你们能意识到这有多糟糕，詹森现在已经不再参与美国创新的未来了。我们应该谈论开放模型。我的意思是，他是大冠军，对吧？ Dylan，你之前说过——我仍然不太明白为什么有人不花几十亿美元做出比 Kimi 或 DeepSeek 更好的东西并将其开源。

title: Sean Duffy blames Friday's FAA outage on copper-to-fiber wiring work at a remote facility, saying contractor L3Harris may have installed a "faulty router" (Joseph Pisani/Wall Street Journal)
title_en: Sean Duffy blames Friday's FAA outage on copper-to-fiber wiring work at a remote facility, saying contractor L3Harris may have installed a "faulty router" (Joseph Pisani/Wall Street Journal)
author: Wall Street Journal
article_content:
L3Harris, a long time contractor for the Federal Aviation Administration, was doing routine maintenance in at least one of FAA's remote locations changing copper wire to fiber, he said. Duffy said the routers in these facilities were manufactured in 2001. These updates have been happening in American institutions for decades, Duffy said.

"Virtually every single institution in America has gone from copper to fiber, from analog to digital," Duffy said. "Just maybe the FAA is the last one to be doing this work because the investments haven't been made, but this is not complicated."

L3Harris did not immediately respond to NPR's request for comment.

Duffy said the FAA is still investigating the exact error that started flooding other routers in the air traffic control system.

"It's pretty straightforward work that we were doing yesterday at, again, a very remote location. So what we're working to determine was whether we had incompetence, meaning was it user error, installator error from L3Harris, or did they install a faulty router?"

Bryan Bedford, the FAA administrator, who joined Duffy at the briefing said there was no evidence of anything nefarious happening or AI-related issues.

Tens of thousands of passengers across the U.S. are still stranded Saturday after a rare ground stop halted all flights.

The chaos is expected to linger for days.

The aviation system is back online and slowly returning to normal Saturday morning, but delays and cancellations will continue after yesterday's nationwide ground stop, Duffy said in the press briefing Saturday.

"Based on everything that we're hearing from our airline partners, they believe that they'll be able to have full schedule integrity by the close of business on Sunday," Bedford said.

Duffy told reporters Friday night: "I think we're going to be back up and operational as we come into the heat of travel during Thanksgiving."

For about four hours on Friday, thousands of flights at U.S. airports were grounded in one of the biggest disruptions of the nation's air travel system since the terrorist attacks on September 11, 2001.

Nearly 25,000 flights were delayed, and over 9,000 were cancelled on Friday, according to FlightAware, a flight tracking site. The disruption seeped into Saturday morning with more than 4,000 cancellations recorded. That's 14% of flights departing the U.S., according to data from Cirium, which tracks aviation analytics.

Duffy said Friday that air traffic control facilities had experienced "intermittent" outages of their radar and communications systems beginning earlier in the afternoon. Duffy blamed "old switches, old routers" for the failures. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin joined Duffy in the White House briefing room and said there was no evidence the issue was due to an attack.

Flight boards at airports across the country Saturday morning continued to be riddled with red cancelled marks. At Tampa International Airport in Florida, people in the main terminal area before security curled up in chairs to grab a wink of sleep.

On Friday night, a flight board at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport in D.C. showed dozens of flights delayed into the early morning hours or cancelled.

Passengers Erin and Jake Britt spent half the day at the airport in D.C. on Friday. Their plane to Fort Lauderdale, Fla. boarded at 3 p.m. By 5:30 p.m., they were getting off the plane — but they were still in D.C.

"Overall, our plane was definitely annoyed, but reasonable," Erin Britt said, as the couple left the airport at 8pm. "People being upset and asking like, 'Well, how are you not prepared for this?' And it was like, 'Well, no one was prepared.'"

She said neither the pilot nor flight attendants had any more information than passengers."They seem just as in the dark," she said.

The pair decided to cancel their weekend trip, but the night didn't end there. They spent over nine hours overnight waiting on the JetBlue customer service call line to be reimbursed. "I was setting alarms in 20 minute intervals in case I fell asleep," Erin Britt said.

For people who had events or plans over the weekend – the delay added an extra layer of stress. Joe Romano and Maddie Cabana had a cruise leaving Orlando, Fla. Saturday afternoon.

"It was a big eye roll. I mean, I travel a lot for work already, so I'm constantly dealing with flight delays," Romano said. "When this happened, I was just like, 'Of course, it always happens to me.'"

"Just rather inconvenient and frustrating," Cabana added, as the pair contemplated checking their bags or going home. "Hopefully, everything will be fine. It'll all work out. It always does."

And it did – eventually. After their JetBlue flight was ultimately cancelled, they quickly booked another one on Southwest Airlines and made it early Saturday morning.

"My husband, my hero, is driving down from New Jersey to come get me," DiPietro said.

Other alternatives included people switching to Amtrak trains as they struggled to get to their destination. Although, even Amtrak's system had a brief outage Friday night.

This was only the second nationwide ground stop since September 11, 2001. The U.S. last issued a ground stop of this scale in 2023, when all U.S. airports were shut down due to an outage in the NOTAM (Notice to Air Missions) system, which alerts pilots and airports of real-time hazards.

That outage prompted fears of a cyberattack, but the FAA later determined the issue was caused when contract workers inadvertently deleted critical files.

The FAA has recently begun rolling out an AI-enhanced software tool known as the SMART system as part of its ambitious overhaul of the nation's air traffic control system. But Air Space Intelligence, the company that makes the tool, quickly dismissed speculation that its product could be connected to the flight disruptions.

"The current ground stop is not based on or a result of the SMART system, any product of ASI or our integration with FAA and ATC," the company said on social media.
content_snippet: Work at a single remote location caused instability that led authorities to order nationwide groundstop; airlines continue to cancel flights as they rush to reset

The investigation currently focuses on whether long-time contractor L3Harris installed a faulty router or committed installation errors, which triggered a network flood within the air traffic control system.

title_zh: 美国联邦航空局系统中断排查，指向承包商设备更新
summary_zh: 美国联邦航空局因基础设施更新导致全国航班大面积停飞，目前调查焦点集中于承包商L3Harris在远程设施升级中的路由器故障

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 美国联邦航空局（FAA）局长布莱恩·贝德福德与相关官员指出，此次导致全国航班大规模停飞的系统中断源于远程设施将铜缆升级为光纤的维护作业。初步调查聚焦于长期承包商L3Harris是否在更新过程中安装了故障路由器，或存在施工人员操作失误，引发空中交通管制系统内部网络泛洪。

The investigation currently focuses on whether long-time contractor L3Harris installed a faulty router or committed installation errors, which triggered a network flood within the air traffic control system.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 此次事件暴露了关键基础设施高度依赖老旧硬件（部分路由器产自2001年）与技术迭代滞后的系统性风险。当航空系统从模拟向数字化强行跨越时，缺乏容错冗余的架构极易因单一承包商的作业疏失引发连锁性瘫痪，显示出关键领域技术外包合规审查与应急恢复能力的紧迫性。
ai_analysis.insight_en: This incident highlights systemic risks inherent in relying on legacy hardware (some routers dating back to 2001) while forcing digital transformations. The total system collapse following a single contractor's maintenance error reveals an urgent need for enhanced compliance oversight and redundant fail-safes in critical infrastructure maintenance.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 美国联邦航空局（FAA）局长布莱恩·贝德福德与相关官员指出，此次导致全国航班大规模停飞的系统中断源于远程设施将铜缆升级为光纤的维护作业。初步调查聚焦于长期承包商L3Harris是否在更新过程中安装了故障路由器，或存在施工人员操作失误，引发空中交通管制系统内部网络泛洪。
ai_analysis.digest_en: FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford and officials identified that the nationwide flight ground stop was caused by maintenance work upgrading copper wiring to fiber at a remote facility. The investigation currently focuses on whether long-time contractor L3Harris installed a faulty router or committed installation errors, which triggered a network flood within the air traffic control system.
key_points_zh: 核心调查指向L3Harris在远程设施的铜改光缆施工过程中安装了故障路由器或存在人为操作失误。
事故造成全国范围内超2.5万次航班延误，超9000次航班取消，系统中断持续约4小时。
FAA预计将于周日恢复全面日程完整性，目前已排除网络攻击及AI相关故障的可能。

The incident caused over 25,000 delays and 9,000 cancellations, with a 4-hour system-wide ground stop.

article_content_zh:
L3Harris 是美国联邦航空管理局的长期承包商，他说，他正在至少一个联邦航空管理局的偏远地点进行日常维护，将铜线更换为光纤。达菲说，这些设施中的路由器是 2001 年制造的。达菲说，美国机构几十年来一直在进行这些更新。

“几乎美国的每个机构都已经从铜缆转向光纤，从模拟转向数字，”达菲说。 “也许联邦航空局是最后一个开展这项工作的机构，因为尚未进行投资，但这并不复杂。”

L3Harris 没有立即回应 NPR 的置评请求。

达菲表示，美国联邦航空局仍在调查导致空中交通管制系统中其他路由器泛滥的确切错误。

“这是我们昨天在一个非常偏远的地点所做的非常简单的工作。因此，我们正在努力确定我们是否有能力不足，这意味着是用户错误、L3Harris 安装程序错误，还是他们安装了有故障的路由器？”

美国联邦航空局局长布莱恩·贝德福德 (Bryan Bedford) 与达菲一起参加了吹风会，他表示没有证据表明发生了任何邪恶的事情或与人工智能相关的问题。

周六，由于一次罕见的地面停留导致所有航班停飞，美国各地仍有数万名乘客滞留。

混乱预计将持续数天。

达菲在周六的新闻发布会上表示，航空系统已重新上线，并在周六早上慢慢恢复正常，但在昨天的全国地面停留后，延误和取消仍将继续。

贝德福德说：“根据我们从航空公司合作伙伴那里听到的一切信息，他们相信，在周日营业结束前，他们将能够保持完整的航班时刻表。”

达菲周五晚上告诉记者：“我认为，随着感恩节期间旅行的热潮，我们将恢复正常运营。”

周五，美国机场数千架航班停飞约四个小时，这是自 2001 年 9 月 11 日恐怖袭击以来美国航空旅行系统遭受的最严重的干扰之一。

根据航班跟踪网站 FlightAware 的数据，周五有近 25,000 架航班延误，超过 9,000 架航班被取消。服务中断一直持续到周六上午，记录显示有 4,000 多起航班被取消。根据跟踪航空分析的 Cirium 的数据，这占从美国出发的航班的 14%。

达菲周五表示，从下午早些时候开始，空中交通管制设施的雷达和通信系统出现“间歇性”中断。达菲将故障归咎于“旧交换机、旧路由器”。国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林和达菲一起在白宫新闻发布室表示，没有证据表明该问题是由袭击造成的。

title: Sean Duffy blames Friday's FAA outage on copper-to-fiber wiring work at a remote facility, saying contractor L3Harris may have installed a "faulty router" (Joseph Pisani/Wall Street Journal)
title_en: Sean Duffy blames Friday's FAA outage on copper-to-fiber wiring work at a remote facility, saying contractor L3Harris may have installed a "faulty router" (Joseph Pisani/Wall Street Journal)
author: Wall Street Journal
article_content:
Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said Saturday that air traffic operations had fully resumed after a telecommunications problem disrupted flights Friday, prompting a ground stop while about 3,500 aircraft were airborne.At a news conference, Duffy said preliminary findings pointed to work at a remote Federal Aviation Administration location, where contractor L3Harris was replacing aging copper telecommunications lines with fiber.A router involved in that work began flooding other routers with more than 1,000 connection attempts every four to five seconds, disrupting communications with aircraft and some radar feeds, Duffy said.Officials were still determining whether the problem stemmed from a faulty router or an installation error.

Duffy said authorities did not believe a cyberattack was responsible."Once we were able to isolate the work that was being done at this remote location, all of our systems came back online," he said.In a statement Saturday, L3Harris explained that it has been working in close coordination with the FAA on the conversion from legacy copper wires to a fiber optic system, and indicated the project is 70% completed.

"We are supporting the FAA in its investigation to understand the conditions that led to the Nov. 13 ground stop of our nation’s air travel," the statement continued.Duffy credited air traffic controllers and pilots with safely landing the aircraft and thanked passengers for their patience during the disruption.He also urged Congress to provide additional funding to modernize the air traffic control system.

Duffy said the FAA has replaced 69% of its copper communications with high-speed fiber as part of upgrades supported by $12.5 billion Congress provided."Americans want less delays. They want less cancellations," Duffy said.More than 2,500 flights were canceled in the U.S. on Saturday and hundreds more were delayed, according to FlightAware, a website that tracks flight disruptions.That’s on top of more than 9,000 canceled flights and 7,000 delayed flights on Friday.

FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said the air travel schedule should be back to normal by the end of Sunday. He said airlines "will still have delays and cancellations" Saturday but assured the "worst is behind us."Airlines are obligated to offer free rebooking on another flight for travelers who want to continue their journey, or a refund if their flight was canceled and they decide not to take the trip.Delta and United announced they were offering travel waivers.

MORE: Airlines issue travel waivers during national ground stopPassengers should contact their airlines for information about their flights and any potential compensation, the FAA said. A new rule that went into effect last month could make it harder for airline customers to get compensated.

Effective Oct. 19, the Department of Transportation removed 10 events from being considered "within an airline's control," removing the ability for flyers to be compensated. RELATED: Nationwide ground stop: How new DOT rule could affect compensation for flight delaysAmong the 10 events are "government system failures," or unexpected shutdowns or technical failures of government systems that directly impact safe flight operations.Duffy suggested more disruptions might occur in coming days, but officials say the system is likely to be operating normally in time to handle the Thanksgiving travel rush.
content_snippet: Work at a single remote location caused instability that led authorities to order nationwide groundstop; airlines continue to cancel flights as they rush to reset

title_zh: 美联邦交通部长披露航空停飞因路由器故障引起
summary_zh: 美国交通部长Sean Duffy指出，FAA远程设施更换光纤过程中的路由器故障导致了全美大规模航班停飞
article_content_zh:
运输部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 周六表示，周五的电信问题导致航班中断，导致大约 3,500 架飞机停飞，导致空中交通运营完全恢复。达菲在新闻发布会上表示，初步调查结果表明，联邦航空管理局的一个偏远地点正在开展工作，承包商 L3Harris 正在那里用光纤更换老化的铜质电信线路。参与这项工作的路由器开始向其他路由器发送每四到五秒超过 1,000 次的连接尝试，从而中断了与飞机的通信达菲说，还有一些雷达信号。官员们仍在确定问题是否源于路由器故障或安装错误。

达菲表示，当局认为网络攻击不是罪魁祸首。他说：“一旦我们能够隔离在这个偏远地点进行的工作，我们所有的系统就恢复正常。”在周六的一份声明中，L3Harris 解释说，它一直在与 FAA 密切合作，将传统铜线转换为光纤系统，并表示该项目已完成 70%。

声明继续说道：“我们正在支持美国联邦航空局进行调查，以了解导致我国航空旅行于 11 月 13 日地面停止的原因。”达菲称赞空中交通管制员和飞行员使飞机安全着陆，并感谢乘客在中断期间的耐心等待。他还敦促国会提供额外资金，以实现空中交通管制系统的现代化。

达菲表示，作为国会提供的 125 亿美元支持的升级的一部分，美国联邦航空管理局已将 69% 的铜缆通信替换为高速光纤。达菲说：“美国人希望减少延误。他们希望减少取消。”根据跟踪航班中断情况的网站 FlightAware 的数据，周六美国有 2,500 多个航班被取消，数百个航班被延误。这是在 9,000 多个航班被取消和周五有 7,000 架航班延误。

美国联邦航空局局长布莱恩·贝德福德表示，航空旅行时间表应在周日结束前恢复正常。他表示，航空公司周六“仍会出现延误和取消”，但保证“最糟糕的情况已经过去”。航空公司有义务为想要继续旅程的旅客免费重新预订另一趟航班，或者在航班被取消而他们决定不参加旅行的情况下退款。达美航空和联合航空宣布将提供旅行豁免。

更多信息：航空公司在国家地面停留期间发放旅行豁免 美国联邦航空局表示，乘客应联系航空公司，了解有关航班的信息以及任何潜在的赔偿。上个月生效的一项新规定可能会使航空公司客户更难获得补偿。

自 10 月 19 日起，美国运输部取消了 10 起“航空公司控制范围内”的事件，并取消了乘客获得补偿的资格。相关报道：全国范围内的地面停止：交通部的新规定如何影响航班延误的赔偿 在这 10 起事件中，有“政府系统故障”，即直接影响安全飞行运营的政府系统意外关闭或技术故障。达菲表示，未来几天可能会发生更多干扰，但官员们表示，该系统很可能及时正常运行，以应对感恩节旅行高峰。

title: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Google's Gemini 4 Carbon has become the first non-OpenAI model in a while to top the MathArena math benchmark. It knocked GPT-6.1 Sol from the top spot, while Claude Fable 5.2 came in second, making it potentially one of the most capable publicly available models for math tasks. OpenAI's models, which recently allegedly solved demanding equations like the Navier-Stokes equations, aren't publicly available yet.

Gemini 4 Carbon's most common failure mode is exceeding the time limit. The model also almost never gives up on a task, a trait that can be read as either positive or negative. In one case, it launched a script that ran for more than eleven hours without checking on its progress. That extra performance comes at a price, though. With the reasoning settings used in testing, Carbon and Fable 5.2 cost roughly 15 and 40 times as much as GPT-6.1 Sol, respectively.

title: Anthropic says outdated prompting habits are slowing down Claude Opus 5.5
title_en: Anthropic says outdated prompting habits are slowing down Claude Opus 5.5

inline_images.caption: Anthropic's prompting tips for Opus 5.5 include connecting files and systems, describing the desired end result, dropping "think hard," starting at Medium effor
inline_images.alt: Anthropic's prompting tips for Opus 5.5 include connecting files and systems, describing the desired

author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Anyone using Claude Opus 5.5 should first drop several prompting habits carried over from older model generations, according to Anthropic.

Anthropic says the model, now the default on Pro, Max, Ultra, and Team plans, works differently from its predecessors and that many users hold it back with outdated instructions.

Topping the list is Anthropic's advice to cut phrases like "think hard" or "think carefully" from prompts. According to the company, the model always reasons on its own and scales its reasoning depth to the task and the selected effort level. In Anthropic's tests, responses without these phrases started faster with no measurable drop in quality.Ad

These phrases date back to the early days of reasoning models, before today's standard adaptive reasoning existed. "Back then," meaning about a year and a half ago, users could sometimes coax more performance out of a model or steer the router this way.Ad

Anthropic also recommends starting at the "Medium" effort level, the default for Opus 5.5. In internal tests, Opus 5.5 on Medium matched the performance of its predecessor Opus 5 on "High," the company says. Higher settings cost more and don't always produce better results. Anthropic advises switching to "High" only when Medium isn't enough, and users can change the setting in the model menu next to the send button.

Teams that previously used the cheaper Sonnet and reserved Opus for complex projects should rethink that approach, according to Anthropic. The company argues that a more capable model can finish a task in fewer steps, which can partly offset its higher per-token price. Anyone who regularly cranks Sonnet up to "Extra High" or "Max" effort ends up paying about as much as with Opus 5.5, Anthropic says.Ad

Anthropic advises describing the desired result in a single message rather than giving instructions one at a time, covering the goal, the output format, and when the model should check back with questions. Opus 5.5 is better than its predecessor at seeing multi-part tasks through, according to the company. The model can increasingly take over the back-and-forth users used to handle in the chat, sometimes doing it better, and effectively prompt itself from a single initial input.

Anthropic recommends attaching diagrams and tables as images or files instead of typing them out. Workarounds that older models required, such as manually transcribing chart values, are no longer needed, the company says.Ad

Users who need a finished document or spreadsheet should ask for it directly instead of requesting a draft first. Opus 5.5 often goes from request to finished product in a single pass, the company says. Image reading also improved significantly in Opus 5.5. Even at the lowest effort level, it read values from dense charts more accurately than Opus 5 at the highest, the firm says.Ad

For design tasks, Anthropic recommends naming unwanted styles specifically, such as a cream-colored background or pill-shaped buttons, rather than vaguely banning "generic design." According to the company, general instructions only swap one default style for another.

Users who connect Claude to their own files and systems through connectors get significantly more tailored results, Anthropic says, because the model can pull in the information it needs on its own.

article_content_zh:
据 Anthropic 称，任何使用 Claude Opus 5.5 的人都应该首先放弃一些从老一代型号中继承下来的提示习惯。

Anthropic 表示，该模型现在是 Pro、Max、Ultra 和 Team 计划的默认模型，其工作原理与其前身不同，并且许多用户使用过时的说明来阻止它。

排在首位的是 Anthropic 建议从提示中删除“认真思考”或“仔细思考”等短语。据该公司称，该模型始终自行推理，并根据任务和选定的努力水平调整推理深度。在 Anthropic 的测试中，没有这些短语的反应开始得更快，而且质量没有明显下降。

这些短语可以追溯到推理模型的早期，在今天的标准自适应推理存在之前。 “那时候”，意思是大约一年半前，用户有时可以从模型中获得更高的性能，或者以这种方式引导路由器。

Anthropic 还建议从“中等”努力级别开始，这是 Opus 5.5 的默认值。该公司表示，在内部测试中，Opus 5.5 在“Medium”上的性能与其前身 Opus 5 在“High”上的性能相当。设置越高，成本越高，并且并不总是能产生更好的结果。 Anthropic 建议仅当“中”不够时才切换到“高”，并且用户可以在发送按钮旁边的模型菜单中更改设置。

Anthropic 表示，之前使用更便宜的 Sonnet 并为复杂项目保留 Opus 的团队应该重新考虑这种方法。该公司认为，功能更强大的模型可以用更少的步骤完成任务，这可以部分抵消其较高的每代币价格。 Anthropic 表示，任何经常将 Sonnet 调到“超高”或“最大”强度的人最终都会付出与 Opus 5.5 一样多的费用。

Anthropic 建议在一条消息中描述所需的结果，而不是一次给出一个指令，包括目标、输出格式以及模型何时应检查问题。据该公司称，Opus 5.5 在处理多部分任务方面比其前身更好。该模型可以越来越多地接管用户在聊天中处理的来回操作，有时做得更好，并通过单个初始输入有效地提示自己。

Anthropic 建议将图表和表格作为图像或文件附加，而不是打印出来。该公司表示，不再需要旧模型所需的解决方法，例如手动转录图表值。

需要成品文档或电子表格的用户应直接索取，而不是先索取草稿。该公司表示，Opus 5.5 通常从请求到成品只需一次即可完成。 Opus 5.5 的图像读取能力也显着提高。该公司表示，即使在最低的努力水平上，它从密集的图表中读取值的准确性也比最高水平的 Opus 5 更高。

对于设计任务，Anthropic 建议专门命名不需要的样式，例如奶油色背景或药丸形按钮，而不是含糊地禁止“通用设计”。据该公司称，一般说明仅将一种默认样式替换为另一种默认样式。

Anthropic 表示，通过连接器将 Claude 连接到自己的文件和系统的用户可以获得更加定制的结果，因为该模型可以自行提取所需的信息。

title: Trump Media faces a Nov. 30 deadline to repay up to $1B in convertible bonds sold last May to fund a "bitcoin treasury," as its shares are down 60+% this year (Financial Times)
title_en: Trump Media faces a Nov. 30 deadline to repay up to $1B in convertible bonds sold last May to fund a "bitcoin treasury," as its shares are down 60+% this year (Financial Times)
author: Financial Times
article_content:
The Crypto Desk desk. Editor: Sam Daodu.

This post may contain links from our sponsors and affiliates, and Flywheel Publishing may receive compensation for actions taken through them.

Wallets linked to Trump Media (NASDAQ: DJT), labeled as “2028 Convertible Notes Collateral,” transferred 4,259 Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) to Crypto.com, according to Arkham data. While no sale has been confirmed, blockchain data shows the coins’ movement without clarifying whether they were sold. These Bitcoins are tied to a debt, and creditors can demand repayment of about $1 billion by November 30.

Arkham tracked the transfer of the coins in two batches, 2,140.03 BTC and 2,119.31 BTC, logged within an hour on that day. Subsequently, Whale Alert reported that 4,259 BTC left Crypto.com for an unidentified wallet. Crypto.com operates both an exchange and custody service, so the coins might be headed for either a trading desk or a secure vault.

At present, Bitcoin trades at $76,517, down 4.8% over the last 24 hours, back below $80,000 after closing above that level on November 4. Trump Media shares are trading at $4.54, up 1% but down 24% over the past week.

Convertible notes are essentially loans that can be converted into company stock at a later date. Trump Media has pledged Bitcoin as collateral for its 2028 convertible notes. This means that if the company fails to repay its lenders, those lenders can claim the Bitcoin. The number of Bitcoins transferred aligns with the amount pledged as collateral in a recent quarterly report.

Although the notes mature in 2028, holders can demand repayment of about $1 billion on November 30. This looming deadline has raised eyebrows, especially after the recent collateral transfer.

Despite reporting a surge in revenue, with Trump Media generating $1.7 million in the second quarter—an 89% year-over-year increase—this amount pales in comparison to its $1.9 billion in financial assets. Non-cash losses during the same quarter hit $190.4 million due to unliquidated holdings.

Market analyst Charlie Bilello pointed out that Trump Media’s stock has plummeted 97% from its peak, reaching another all-time low. With cumulative losses of $1.8 billion since its inception, shares have dropped by 11% following the Democrats’ control of Congress, putting DJT down 66% for the year.

The company is also pursuing a merger with TAE Technologies, expected to close in the fourth quarter. Both the merger and the impending repayment deadline will be significant factors for management as the year wraps up.

Trump Media has not publicly addressed the Bitcoin transfers, nor has it filed any new Form 8-K with the SEC to report significant developments. Without a named buyer, sale price, or counterparty, the purpose of the Bitcoin transfer remains uncertain.

Whale Alert’s information further complicates matters because it cannot distinguish whether the transfer was an over-the-counter sale, a custody transfer, or an internal wallet shuffle. While deposits to exchanges often precede sales, the trail lacks clarity at this unknown address.

With Bitcoin priced at $76,517, the 4,259 BTC are valued at about $326 million. However, even if the Bitcoin were sold, the amount wouldn’t fully cover the $1 billion debt if all lenders requested cash.

While a 4,259 BTC transaction is significant for one wallet, it represents only a small fraction of the overall market. On November 4, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs took in a net $74.6 million, ending a three-day streak that pulled $1.3 billion from Bitcoin and Ethereum funds. Trump Media’s Bitcoin represents 4.4 times the amount brought into the ETFs that day.

This 4,259 BTC transfer signifies about 0.02% of Bitcoin’s circulating supply of roughly 20.1 million coins. Although a sale could momentarily affect the price, it remains a minor part of the total market. The name “Trump” also appears in connection with American Bitcoin (NASDAQ: ABTC), a distinct mining company that reported net income of about $126 million in the third quarter, although this data pertains to a different entity.

While no definitive sale has occurred, the transfer does not confirm one either. Moving coins from a collateral wallet to an exchange, then to an unknown address, could indicate a sale, a custody shift, or an arrangement with lenders—but without more information from Trump Media, the narrative remains open-ended.

Regardless of the path Trump Media chooses, a sale or transfer to lenders could help reduce its debt, while repayment in cash would let the company keep the Bitcoin on its books. For Bitcoin, the implications are minimal, as a corporate debt decision wouldn’t create new buyers, and a sale would only add to the supply.

A sale of 4,259 BTC seems unlikely to crash Bitcoin’s price, since it accounts for only about 0.02% of the total supply. Bitcoin’s broader issue lies in the ongoing trend of its value, as it currently trades 39.3% below its all-time high of $126,080. It remains below its 20-day and 50-day moving averages but stays above its 200-day average.

Contact [email protected] for any questions or corrections.

Sam Daodu is a crypto analyst and the editor of 24/7 Wall St.'s Crypto Desk, where he covers Bitcoin, XRP, Ethereum, Solana and the altcoins investors search for most. His work focuses on price levels, spot ETF flows, on-chain data and the regulatory decisions that move crypto markets, written so a first-time buyer and a seasoned trader can both use it. Sam has written about crypto professionally since 2019 and has published more than 2,000 articles. Before joining 24/7 Wall St., he wrote for crypto media outlets and Web3 companies and ghostwrote for crypto founders and token launches. His analysis is syndicated on Yahoo Finance, MSN and AOL and has been cited by other crypto news sites. He also founded MacLabs Marketing, a content and personal branding agency for crypto founders and executives. When he isn't reading charts, Sam is usually at the gym or watching One Piece, a series he maintains has better tokenomics than most altcoins.

Wallets linked to Trump Media (NASDAQ: DJT), labeled as “2028 Convertible Notes Collateral,” transferred 4,259 Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) to Crypto.com, according to Arkham data. While no sale has been confirmed, blockchain data shows the coins’ movement without clarifying whether they were sold. These Bitcoins are tied to a debt, and creditors can demand repayment of about $1 billion by November 30.

Arkham tracked the transfer of the coins in two batches, 2,140.03 BTC and 2,119.31 BTC, logged within an hour on that day. Subsequently, Whale Alert reported that 4,259 BTC left Crypto.com for an unidentified wallet. Crypto.com operates both an exchange and custody service, so the coins might be headed for either a trading desk or a secure vault.

At present, Bitcoin trades at $76,517, down 4.8% over the last 24 hours, back below $80,000 after closing above that level on November 4. Trump Media shares are trading at $4.54, up 1% but down 24% over the past week.

Convertible notes are essentially loans that can be converted into company stock at a later date. Trump Media has pledged Bitcoin as collateral for its 2028 convertible notes. This means that if the company fails to repay its lenders, those lenders can claim the Bitcoin. The number of Bitcoins transferred aligns with the amount pledged as collateral in a recent quarterly report.

Although the notes mature in 2028, holders can demand repayment of about $1 billion on November 30. This looming deadline has raised eyebrows, especially after the recent collateral transfer.

Despite reporting a surge in revenue, with Trump Media generating $1.7 million in the second quarter—an 89% year-over-year increase—this amount pales in comparison to its $1.9 billion in financial assets. Non-cash losses during the same quarter hit $190.4 million due to unliquidated holdings.

Market analyst Charlie Bilello pointed out that Trump Media’s stock has plummeted 97% from its peak, reaching another all-time low. With cumulative losses of $1.8 billion since its inception, shares have dropped by 11% following the Democrats’ control of Congress, putting DJT down 66% for the year.

The company is also pursuing a merger with TAE Technologies, expected to close in the fourth quarter. Both the merger and the impending repayment deadline will be significant factors for management as the year wraps up.

Trump Media has not publicly addressed the Bitcoin transfers, nor has it filed any new Form 8-K with the SEC to report significant developments. Without a named buyer, sale price, or counterparty, the purpose of the Bitcoin transfer remains uncertain.

Whale Alert’s information further complicates matters because it cannot distinguish whether the transfer was an over-the-counter sale, a custody transfer, or an internal wallet shuffle. While deposits to exchanges often precede sales, the trail lacks clarity at this unknown address.

With Bitcoin priced at $76,517, the 4,259 BTC are valued at about $326 million. However, even if the Bitcoin were sold, the amount wouldn’t fully cover the $1 billion debt if all lenders requested cash.

While a 4,259 BTC transaction is significant for one wallet, it represents only a small fraction of the overall market. On November 4, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs took in a net $74.6 million, ending a three-day streak that pulled $1.3 billion from Bitcoin and Ethereum funds. Trump Media’s Bitcoin represents 4.4 times the amount brought into the ETFs that day.

This 4,259 BTC transfer signifies about 0.02% of Bitcoin’s circulating supply of roughly 20.1 million coins. Although a sale could momentarily affect the price, it remains a minor part of the total market. The name “Trump” also appears in connection with American Bitcoin (NASDAQ: ABTC), a distinct mining company that reported net income of about $126 million in the third quarter, although this data pertains to a different entity.

While no definitive sale has occurred, the transfer does not confirm one either. Moving coins from a collateral wallet to an exchange, then to an unknown address, could indicate a sale, a custody shift, or an arrangement with lenders—but without more information from Trump Media, the narrative remains open-ended.

Regardless of the path Trump Media chooses, a sale or transfer to lenders could help reduce its debt, while repayment in cash would let the company keep the Bitcoin on its books. For Bitcoin, the implications are minimal, as a corporate debt decision wouldn’t create new buyers, and a sale would only add to the supply.

A sale of 4,259 BTC seems unlikely to crash Bitcoin’s price, since it accounts for only about 0.02% of the total supply. Bitcoin’s broader issue lies in the ongoing trend of its value, as it currently trades 39.3% below its all-time high of $126,080. It remains below its 20-day and 50-day moving averages but stays above its 200-day average.

title_zh: 特朗普媒体面临10亿美元可转债赎回压力与清算风险
summary_zh: 特朗普媒体科技集团（DJT）需在11月30日前应对10亿美元可转债赎回压力，公司已将约4259枚比特币作为抵押品转出
article_content_zh:
Crypto Desk 办公桌。编辑：萨姆·道杜。

这篇文章可能包含来自我们的赞助商和附属机构的链接，Flywheel Publishing 可能会因通过他们采取的行动而获得补偿。

根据 Arkham 的数据，与 Trump Media（纳斯达克股票代码：DJT）关联、标记为“2028 年可转换票据抵押品”的钱包将 4,259 比特币（CRYPTO：BTC）转移到 Crypto.com。虽然尚未确认任何销售，但区块链数据显示了代币的动向，但没有澄清它们是否已被出售。这些比特币与债务挂钩，债权人可以要求在 11 月 30 日之前偿还约 10 亿美元。

Arkham 追踪了两批代币的转移，即 2,140.03 BTC 和 2,119.31 BTC，记录在当天一小时内。随后，Whale Alert 报告称，有 4,259 枚 BTC 离开 Crypto.com，进入了一个身份不明的钱包。 Crypto.com 同时运营交易和托管服务，因此硬币可能会被送往交易台或安全金库。

目前，比特币交易价格为 76,517 美元，过去 24 小时下跌 4.8%，在 11 月 4 日收盘高于该水平后回到 80,000 美元以下。特朗普媒体股价交易价格为 4.54 美元，上涨 1%，但过去一周下跌 24%。

可转换票据本质上是可以在以后转换为公司股票的贷款。特朗普媒体已承诺将比特币作为其 2028 年可转换票据的抵押品。这意味着，如果该公司未能偿还贷方，这些贷方可以索取比特币。转移的比特币数量与最近季度报告中承诺作为抵押品的数量一致。

尽管这些票据将于 2028 年到期，但持有人可以在 11 月 30 日要求偿还约 10 亿美元。这一迫在眉睫的最后期限引起了人们的关注，尤其是在最近的抵押品转让之后。

尽管特朗普媒体报告收入大幅增长，第二季度创收 170 万美元，同比增长 89%，但与 19 亿美元的金融资产相比，这一数字显得相形见绌。由于未清算持股，同一季度的非现金损失达到 1.904 亿美元。

市场分析师查理·比莱洛指出，特朗普媒体的股价已从峰值暴跌97%，再创历史新低。自成立以来，DJT 累计亏损 18 亿美元，在民主党控制国会后，其股价已下跌 11%，全年股价下跌 66%。

该公司还在寻求与 TAE Technologies 的合并，预计将于第四季度完成。随着今年的结束，合并和即将到来的还款期限都将成为管理层面临的重要因素。

特朗普媒体尚未公开讨论比特币转移问题，也没有向 SEC 提交任何新的 8-K 表格来报告重大进展。如果没有指定的买家、销售价格或交易对手，比特币转移的目的仍然不确定。

Whale Alert 的信息使事情变得更加复杂，因为它无法区分转移是场外交易、托管转移还是内部钱包洗牌。虽然向交易所存款通常先于销售，但这个未知地址的踪迹缺乏明确性。

比特币价格为 76,517 美元，这 4,259 个 BTC 的价值约为 3.26 亿美元。然而，如果所有贷方都要求现金，即使比特币被出售，这笔金额也无法完全偿还 10 亿美元的债务。

虽然 4,259 BTC 的交易对于一个钱包来说意义重大，但它只占整个市场的一小部分。 11 月 4 日，美国现货比特币 ETF 净吸纳 7460 万美元，结束了比特币和以太坊基金连续三天吸纳 13 亿美元的记录。特朗普媒体的比特币是当天进入 ETF 金额的 4.4 倍。

article_content:
And Tesla wants consumers to sign it while still refusing to give unsupervised self-driving to the Model Y owners it has been selling “Full Self-Driving” to for nearly a decade.

That personal-use clause kills the whole pitch. For years, Musk told people they’d buy a Tesla, add it to the fleet, and make money while they sleep. The first Tesla sold to consumers for unsupervised operation is contractually barred from doing exactly that.

Then there’s the geofence. Tesla’s Robotaxi service areas are already smaller in practice than advertised: when we tested them, real coverage was between 59% and 78% of the advertised maps, and parts of the Houston map have been called “fake” by the person tracking it. Now Tesla reserves the right to shrink that area after you’ve paid for the car.

Mark Valorian, who went through the terms on X, summed it up as “an endless variable-rate lease with a ridiculous down payment.” That’s about right.

This is the part that should make every Tesla owner angry.

Tesla has spent the last year telling everyone that its Model Y is just as much a robotaxi as the Cybercab. Ahead of the Robotaxi launch in Austin, Musk said the cars were “the Model Ys we make currently, there’s no change to it.” On Tesla’s Q3 2026 earnings call last month, AI chief Ashok Elluswamy said Cybercabs and Model Y robotaxis already run the same software, and that customer cars might join the network around Q2 2027. The Cybercab launches on the same AI4 computer found in the current Model Y.

So the hardware is the same, the software is the same, and unsupervised Model Ys are already operating in the exact geofences where Cybercab owners will be allowed to ride.

I’ll say it plainly: this car is for suckers who want to give their money to Elon Musk.

You don’t own a Cybercab in any meaningful sense. You pay $30,000 for the right to keep paying Tesla $299 a month, at a price Tesla can raise, in an area Tesla can shrink, under rules Tesla enforces, with a camera pointed at you the whole time.

So what happens the first time Tesla emails Cybercab owners a month’s notice that the price is going to $399?

Not to worry. If there's one thing you can count on in this life it's that Tesla will keep it's pricing stable steady for the long-term.

And the Model Y part is what gives the game away. If Tesla truly believed its unsupervised system was ready for customers, the obvious move would be to turn it on for the Model Y owners in Austin who already paid for it. It’s the same computer and the same software in the same geofence. But that would mean honoring a promise made in 2016, on cars already sold, with no new revenue attached.

article_content_zh:
特斯拉希望消费者签署该协议，同时仍然拒绝向其近十年来一直向其销售“完全自动驾驶”的 Model Y 车主提供无人监督的自动驾驶功能。

个人使用条款毁了整个球场。多年来，马斯克告诉人们，他们会购买一辆特斯拉，将其添加到车队中，然后在睡觉时赚钱。第一辆出售给消费者进行无人监督操作的特斯拉，根据合同禁止这样做。

然后是地理围栏。特斯拉的 Robotaxi 服务区域在实践中已经比广告中的要小：当我们测试它们时，真实覆盖范围在广告地图的 59% 到 78% 之间，休斯敦地图的部分内容被追踪者称为“假”。现在，特斯拉保留在您支付汽车费用后缩小该区域的权利。

马克·瓦洛里安（Mark Valorian）仔细阅读了 X 的条款，将其总结为“无休止的浮动利率租赁，首付金额高得离谱”。差不多是这样。

这是应该让每个特斯拉车主愤怒的部分。

去年，特斯拉一直在告诉所有人，它的 Model Y 与 Cyber​​cab 一样都是机器人出租车。在奥斯汀推出 Robotaxi 之前，马斯克表示这些汽车是“我们目前生产的 Model Y，没有任何改变。”在特斯拉上个月举行的 2026 年第三季度财报电话会议上，人工智能负责人 Ashok Elluswamy 表示，Cyber​​cabs 和 Model Y 机器人出租车已经运行相同的软件，客户汽车可能会在 2027 年第二季度左右加入该网络。Cyber​​cab 在当前 Model Y 中使用的同一台 AI4 计算机上启动。

因此，硬件是相同的，软件是相同的，无人监管的 Model Y 已经在允许 Cyber​​cab 车主乘坐的精确地理围栏中运行。

我会直白地说：这辆车是为那些想把钱捐给埃隆·马斯克的傻瓜准备的。

从任何意义上来说，你都没有拥有一辆 Cyber​​cab。你支付 30,000 美元，就可以继续每月向特斯拉支付 299 美元，特斯拉可以提高价格，根据特斯拉执行的规则，特斯拉可以缩小范围，并且摄像头一直对着你。

那么，当 Tesla 第一次通过电子邮件向 Cyber​​cab 车主发送一个月的价格通知，告知价格将上涨至 399 美元时，会发生什么情况呢？

不用担心。如果说你一生中可以信赖一件事，那就是特斯拉将长期保持其定价稳定。

Model Y 部分才是暴露真相的关键。如果特斯拉真的相信其无人监管系统已经为客户做好了准备，那么显而易见的举措就是为奥斯汀已经付款的 Model Y 车主开启该系统。这是同一地理围栏中的同一台计算机和相同的软件。但这意味着兑现 2016 年对已售汽车做出的承诺，且不附带任何新收入。

title: Italy's data protection agency fines Meta €805M for allegedly accessing Android users' photos and videos without their consent or informing them (Reuters)
title_en: Italy's data protection agency fines Meta €805M for allegedly accessing Android users' photos and videos without their consent or informing them (Reuters)
author: Reuters
article_content:
Italy's privacy regulator has imposed a 805 million euros penalty on Meta Platforms Ireland after finding that the company accessed photos, videos, and related information stored on Android devices without obtaining specific user permission.

The case focuses on a Facebook feature that offered users photo and video suggestions from their phone galleries while they were browsing the app. According to the authority, the feature allowed access to gallery content without providing users with clear information and a separate consent process.

The regulator's investigation began after a consumer complaint and included a technical review of how the feature operated. Following its findings, the authority ordered Meta to switch off the feature by default within 60 days and seek explicit consent before accessing gallery content.
